full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.43 of 2003 in the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Noakhali for permanent injunction on the allegations, inter alia, that one Abdul Latif Mia as owner in possession distributed his properties amongst his heirs vide registered Nirdeshpatra dated 6.3.1944. Accordingly Diara Khatian Nos.77 and 78 of Sonapur Mouza, Noakhali were prepared and recorded in their names. Plaintiff-petitioner and his wife Mst. Monowara Khanam, purchased .57 acres of land from plot Nos.466, 467 and 469 from different recorded tenants between 1991 and 1995 and got their names mutated by opening separate Khatians and then they by means of oral gift dedicated the suit property in favour of Wali Mia Sodagor Jame Masjid and Madrasha, a Wakf Estate with the plaintiff-petitioner as Mutwalli, for establishing a Masjid, Madrasa and Etimkhana. When the construction work for the said Masjid, Madrasa and Etimkhana was nearly complete the defendant-respondent and defendant No.2 claimed that they were the owners of the suit property by virtue of a deed of exchange and started disturbing the construction work and also threatened with dispossession openly declaring that they wouldn't let the plaintiff petitioner build any mosque or madrasa on the said land. In the premises the plaintiff petitioner and his wife Most. Manwara Begum were constrained to file the said suit for permanent injunction.
